{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
__NOTOC__
===Chicken===
*1 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]] boneless [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]], [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]]
*1 lb [[Cookbook:Kidney Bean|kidney beans]]
*½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
*1 tsp [[Cookbook:Chili Powder|chili powder]]
===Salad===
*1 medium [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], [[Cookbook:Chop|chopped]]
*3 medium [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]], diced
*1 lb (about ½ large head) [[Cookbook:Lettuce|lettuce]], chopped
*¼ lb cheddar [[Cookbook:Cheese|cheese]], grated
*1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Thousand Island Dressing|thousand island dressing]]
*¼ cup [[Cookbook:Picante Sauce|picante sauce]] (or to taste)
*1 large [[Cookbook:Avocado|avocado]], peeled and [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]]
*¾ lb corn [[Cookbook:Tortilla Chip|tortilla chips]]

==Procedure==
===Chicken===
#Bone and dice the chicken. 
#Heat a small amount of vegetable oil in a large [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|frying pan]] until it starts to smoke. 
#Add the chicken cubes and [[Cookbook:Frying|fry]] over medium-high heat, stirring frequently, until they are browned (2–3 minutes). 
#To the chicken, add the drained kidney beans, salt and chili powder. 
#Reduce heat and [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] 10 minutes.
===Salad===
#Chop the tomatoes, onion and lettuce. 
#Grate the cheese. 
#[[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|Toss]] them together in a salad bowl with the salad dressing and picante sauce.
# Slice the avocado and add to the salad. 
#Break the tortilla chips into flakes and add to the salad.
#Mix the cooked chicken and beans into the cold salad. 
#Decorate with extra chips and slices of avocado and tomato. 
#Serve immediately.
